name: Plop & Splash

tenures.source: the fed's own served Champions page (promotions/ihwf/archive/champions.html)

caption: Won the IHWF Tag Team Title from Black Gunn/Mercenary at Saturday Night Slaughter -- the belt's own last-attested reign, billed under a joined team name rather than the individually-named pairings the fed's own page uses for every other tag reign, so no individual identities survive.

name: Ultimate Justice

tenures.source: the fed's own served Saturday Night Slaughter broadcast, Hour Three (promotions/ihwf/archive/saturday-night-slaughter-3.html)

caption: A stable named on-air by the fed's own announcers at its later reopening -- "both members of Ultimate Justice" (the Godfather and Mercenary) ran in together to put Jason Slade through a table; Max Powers is separately mocked as its "chump" in the same broadcast, but the corpus never states his membership outright.
